findings.problem: The README upgrade note (README.md:32), repeated in decision 14 (docs/specification/decisions.md:23), says as plain fact that an interactive upgrade puts the app in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Moonzila\MoonAliza\`. findings.evidence: electron-builder 26.15.3 templates. multiUser.nsh setInstallModePerUser sets $INSTDIR from HKCU `Software\${APP_GUID}` InstallLocation; APP_GUID is UUID v5 of appId (NsisTarget.js:157), so it is unchanged. assistedInstaller.nsh instFilesPre does `${StrContains} $0 "${APP_FILENAME}" $INSTDIR` and appends `\MoonAliza` only when the path does not already contain 'MoonAliza'. So a Moonzila build installed interactively over a released MoonAliza install went to `...\Programs\MoonAliza\Moonzila`, because 'Moonzila' is not in the old path. A MoonAliza installer then finds 'MoonAliza' in that path and stays in `...\Programs\MoonAliza\Moonzila\`. That case is likely: the user's PC has `C:\Users\PC\AppData\Local\Programs\MoonAliza\MoonAliza.exe` (docs/handoff/outputs/MoonAliza-build-notes.md:9), and the scout noted 'The earlier MoonAliza-to-Moonzila rename had the same nesting effect' (scout.json:512). DECISIONS R-5 has the same simplification.
